new_src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    full_colors = {row[0] for row in grid if len(set(row)) == 1}
    for row in grid:
        color = row[0]
        if color not in full_colors:
            continue
        end = 0
        while end < w and row[end] == color:
            end += 1
        if 0 < end < w and all(value != color for value in row[end:]):
            for c in range(end, w):
                out[grid.index(row)][c] = 1
    return out
'''
